title: Style sample: systems-blueprint
objective: Show what a systems-blueprint film looks like: one diagram drawn once whose parts change state.
audience: The Motion Lab team, reviewing what each style template looks like before using it.

message.core_message: Only the right key lines every gap up on the shear line, so only it turns the plug.
key_points: Raises the question the mechanism answers.
Names the parts the rest of the film reuses.
Shows why the right key works.
Names the part that blocks the system.
Restates the one idea over the resolved object.

constraints: Silent: no narration, music or effects; the picture carries it.
Built to style template systems-blueprint v1; scene roles follow its scene grammar.

research.reason: Style sample for look review, not a release. On-screen facts are a few well-established figures checked by hand; the source is named on screen.

creative_directions.name: systems-blueprint template
creative_directions.concept: A 22-second walk through the systems-blueprint template's scene grammar on a subject that fits its visual job: How a pin-tumbler lock works.

composition.approach: Portrait only: copy in the top band, the hero in the middle, captions above the bottom UI zone.

creative_directions.pacing: A planned visual event at least every 2 seconds.
creative_directions.why_it_fits: It is the template's own grammar, so the sample shows the template rather than one film's choices.

success_criteria: Each scene role of the template is recognisable
No frame holds still for more than 2.5 s
